objects.description: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has enumerated OS type, OS version, and other information using a script or the "systeminfo" command.(Citation: Securelist Kimsuky Sept 2013)(Citation: Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021) [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has also obtained system information such as OS type, OS version, and system type through querying various Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) classes including `Win32_OperatingSystem`.(Citation: Securonix Kimsuky February 2025)(Citation: Aryaka Kimsuky July 2025)
objects.description_fa: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) نوع سیستم عامل، نسخه سیستم عامل و سایر اطلاعات را با استفاده از یک اسکریپت یا دستور "systeminfo" برشمرده است. نسخه سیستم عامل و نوع سیستم از طریق جستجو در کلاس‌های مختلف ابزار مدیریت ویندوز (WMI) از جمله «Win32_OperatingSystem».(Citation: Securonix Kimsuky February 2025)(Citation: Aryaka Kimsuky July 2025) (Citation: Securelist Kimsuky Sept 2013) (Citation: Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021)
